title: US Clears $2.1bn Patriot Deal for Ukraine; Zelenskyy Seeks Faster Delivery
detail: The US cleared a $2.1 billion Patriot air-defense deal for Ukraine, per an aggregated report dated Oct 31. President Zelenskyy is pressing for faster delivery of the systems.

title: Independent Estimate Puts Russia's War Losses in Ukraine Above 2 Million
detail: An independent estimate reported on Oct 31 finds Russia's total losses in the war against Ukraine exceed 2 million. Methodology and the killed/wounded breakdown were not available in the aggregated summary; Russia publishes no official figures.

title: Hundreds of Thousands of Households Lose Power in Dnipro and Kyiv Regions After Russian Strikes
detail: Russian bombardments left hundreds of thousands of households without electricity in the Dnipro and Kyiv regions, according to Le Monde's live coverage on Oct 31.
